description: The line plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for different configurations of a language model. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The Vanilla line is purple, StrmLLM is blue, SepLLM (n=64) is orange, SepLLM (n=64, H) is green, and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is red. All lines start at a loss of approximately 3.4 and decrease to a loss of around 2.7 by the 140,000th iteration. The lines remain relatively close to each other throughout the plot, with the SepLLM configurations showing slightly lower loss values than the Vanilla and StrmLLM configurations.
